rawContent:
Tweet by @thsottiaux (Tibo)
Author bio: Codex & ChatGPT @OpenAI
Text: If you aren't yet bold enough to install the Codex app, you can stay in the presence of your orange crab and point it at GPT 5.6 Sol. Takes 5 minutes. Kudos to Theo for explaining one of the ways to get this done.

Step 1: Install CLIProxyAPI
Step 2: Connect
Step 3: Define following alias and enjoy claudex

```
alias claudex='CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=gpt-5.6-sol \
CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT=1 \
CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TOOL_USE_CONCURRENCY=3 \
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false \
claude --model gpt-5.6-sol'
```

If this gets blocked, I owe you a reset.
